event.summary: Check whether removing tmux history seeds breaks retained restart history
event.detail: Reviewed commit: 1ed482dde220452e424973faf38a5e1318986333. TLDR: removing the tmux history-seed API could leave a restarted older session without its prior scrollback if a supported restart path still promises or consumes it. Source basis: assigned patch 00961 removes history_seed_from_lines_until, seed_history_capacity, LinesSeed and LineStyles; patch 00964 removes their tests. The commit message says old tmux sessions are ended on startup and now restart into an empty host. Checks made: all assigned patches read; git grep at the reviewed commit finds no remaining references to the removed symbols in crates. Missing premise: the governing old-session shutdown/restart contract and replacement restart path have not yet been read. Next checks: pinned SPEC.md/SPEC_impl.md sections and pre/post restart callers. Suggested bucket: potentially highest for lost user-owned history, pending whether any retained-history guarantee or shipped route exists. Confidence: unresolved lead, not a validated finding. proposed_drop: false. possible_cover: commit message claims intentional empty restart; specification acceptance requires checking. Could-be-highest: yes. No execution or reproduction performed.

event.summary: Old tmux scrollback is no longer carried into Restart; specification accepts this
event.detail: Reviewed commit: 1ed482dde220452e424973faf38a5e1318986333. TLDR: Restart no longer carries an older tmux session's scrollback into a new terminal host. This could otherwise be lost user-owned terminal history, but the pinned product specification expressly accepts empty restarts for old terminals ended by this release. Source basis: patch 00961 removes history_seed_from_lines_until, seed_history_capacity, LinesSeed and LineStyles; patch 00964 removes tests confined to that API. git grep at the reviewed commit found no remaining references to the removed symbols in crates. SPEC_impl.md:2882-2930 says the startup ends the old server and reload treats every old-kind row as having no terminal. Exact acceptance, SPEC.md:1945-1947, Lifecycle operations: "When the terminal no longer exists (the process that kept it ended, after a reboot, or an old terminal this release ended, see [Terminal experience](#terminal-experience)), Restart starts with an empty one." Exact retained-host contrast, SPEC_impl.md:2865-2867: "Restart seeds the new host the same way, with a snapshot of the old terminal's history above a blank screen in default modes, read from the old host's emulator." Suggested bucket: highest if treated as an unaccepted loss of retained terminal history. Confidence: confirmed source/spec consequence; not observed at runtime. proposed_drop: the exact pinned specification acceptance quoted above; requires independent drop check because could-be-highest. possible_cover: that specification only; no queue or excluded coverage sources read. Could-be-highest: yes. Original suspicion preserved: removal could violate history retention if it also affects retained terminal-host seeds; remaining review must verify those APIs and callers survive. No execution or reproduction performed.

event.summary: Removing the tmux seed helpers does not change the v1 snapshot format
event.detail: Reviewed commit: 1ed482dde220452e424973faf38a5e1318986333. TLDR considered: deleting an exported helper from the frozen v1 snapshot module might change saved terminal restoration or the bytes written by supported host snapshots. Source refutation: assigned patch 00963 deletes only sgr_setting, an owned-string adapter over pen_changes used by the removed plain-line seed builder; patch 00962 removes only its re-export. The surviving v1 encoder and decoder remain unchanged. snapshot/v1/mod.rs:246-269 still encodes retained host history through paint::paint_history, and snapshot/mod.rs:573-587 still dispatches version 1 blobs to v1::decode. v1/paint.rs:694-743 retains the actual frozen pen_changes implementation. A crates-wide grep at the reviewed revision found no surviving sgr_setting or removed plain-line seed API reference. Contract: SPEC_impl.md:2831-2838 requires every shipped snapshot format remain readable forever and format changes require a new version. The assigned deletion does not alter that format. Suggested bucket: other for the considered compatibility question; no established adverse consequence. Confidence: confirmed from source, not execution. proposed_drop: source refutation above. possible_cover: none. Could-be-highest: no established loss or security route; the hypothesized format regression is absent. No test or reproduction run.

event.summary: Deleted tmux-seed tests do not remove the surviving host-seed assertions
event.detail: Reviewed commit: 1ed482dde220452e424973faf38a5e1318986333. TLDR considered: deleting the plain-line seed tests might remove regression sensitivity for the history, style, trimming, cancellation or allocation-bound behavior still needed by host restarts. Source assessment addresses the tests themselves, not only correct production code. Assigned patch 00964 deletes tests that all invoke history_seed_from_lines[_until] or seed_history_capacity, which are removed APIs. Their tmux-specific responsibilities are per-line/carried styles, SO/SI interpretation, cut-before accounting, scratch-emulator preallocation and LinesSeed.history_lines reporting; none is used by retained host-to-host seeding. Surviving tests/snapshot.rs:1252-1311 compares each retained primary-history cell, including colors/styles/links, while asserting blank screen/default modes/title/cursors/REP; src/snapshot/mod.rs:835-882 sweeps every cancellation look at full and fitting limits and asserts restored-plus-dropped history accounting. snapshot_golden.rs:426-447,523-531,576-628,634-703 exercises both normal and limited host seeds, compares encoded bytes to fixed blobs and restored state to fixed descriptions, and independently asserts that limited seeds drop some but not all primary history, carry the exact remaining count, mark trimming, clear title and bracketed paste, and show a blank screen. tests/snapshot.rs:1314-1421 still asserts preallocation refusal and the thousand-row history allocation bound and exact retained counts, rather than relying on production correctness as evidence of test sensitivity. No claim is made that these tests cover every possible host-seed input. Contract: SPEC_impl.md Terminal snapshots, 2827-2879, requires immutable shipped formats and bounded history restoration, with host restart seeds. Suggested bucket: other for this considered test-sensitivity concern; no established regression. Confidence: source-supported, not observed execution. proposed_drop: the actual deleted tests address removed parsing/scratch-seed responsibilities, while the listed surviving assertions still distinguish the current host-seed mechanisms; pending caller judgment. possible_cover: none. Could-be-highest: no established security or lost-work route from the test deletion itself. No runtime test or reproduction performed.
